metadata.description: List ID (GUID) of Emerging Leaders Application.
SharePoint site group ID of ELP Reviewers (GET _api/web/sitegroups/getbyname('ELP Reviewers')?$select=Id).
SharePoint site user ID of the automation service account.
Role definition ID for Full Control (SharePoint default; confirm via _api/web/roledefinitions).
Role definition ID for Edit (SharePoint default; confirm via _api/web/roledefinitions).
Program owner who reviews Emerging Leaders applications. One-field change to a shared mailbox.
Shared mailbox the flow sends as (service account needs Send As).
IT operations mailbox that receives failure and hygiene alerts.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: ELP application stopped: item could not be locked – @{variables('varApplicant')}
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
The flow could not restrict permissions on this application, so it stopped before any recommendation request went out. List-level item permissions still limit it to the applicant and reviewers.

Item: @{variables('varItemLink')}
Run: @{concat('https://make.powerautomate.com/environments/', workflow()?['tags']?['environmentName'], '/flows/', workflow()?['name'], '/runs/', workflow()?['run']?['name'])}

runError.message: Item permissions could not be set.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: ELP flow stopped: initial values write failed – @{variables('varApplicant')}
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
ValidateUpdateListItem returned HasException on the initial write. No recommendation requests were sent.

Item: @{variables('varItemLink')}
Run: @{concat('https://make.powerautomate.com/environments/', workflow()?['tags']?['environmentName'], '/flows/', workflow()?['name'], '/runs/', workflow()?['run']?['name'])}

runError.message: Initial values could not be written.

Compose_Invalid_Reason.inputs: @if(equals(toLower(variables('varSupEmail')), toLower(variables('varApplicantEmail'))), 'The applicant named themselves as supervisor.', if(equals(toLower(variables('varAlumEmail')), toLower(variables('varApplicantEmail'))), 'The applicant named themselves as the program alumni recommender.', 'The same person was named as both supervisor and program alumni recommender.'))

parameters.emailMessage/Body:
The application from @{variables('varApplicant')} was stopped before any recommendation request went out.

Reason: @{outputs('Compose_Invalid_Reason')}

Item: @{variables('varItemLink')}

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: FYI: Emerging Leaders supervisor differs from directory manager – @{variables('varApplicant')}
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
@{variables('varApplicant')} named @{variables('varSupName')} as supervisor, but the directory lists @{coalesce(body('Get_Applicant_Manager')?['displayName'], 'no manager')}. The flow is continuing; this is for your awareness.

Item: @{variables('varItemLink')}

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: We received your Emerging Leaders Program application
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Hi @{variables('varApplicant')},

Thank you for applying. We've asked @{variables('varSupName')} and @{variables('varAlumName')} for their recommendations.

To keep applications confidential, you won't be able to view or edit your application after submitting. If you need to change anything, contact the program owner.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Reminder: Emerging Leaders recommendation request for @{variables('varApplicant')}
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Hi @{variables('varSupName')},

This is a reminder that you have a recommendation request for @{variables('varApplicant')}. You'll find it in the Approvals app in Teams, or in your Outlook email from Power Automate.

Your recommendation is confidential and goes only to the program owner.

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: ELP write-back failed: supervisor recommendation for @{variables('varApplicant')}
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
SharePoint returned HasException for the supervisor write-back. The approval response is in run history (secured).

Item: @{variables('varItemLink')}
Run: @{concat('https://make.powerautomate.com/environments/', workflow()?['tags']?['environmentName'], '/flows/', workflow()?['name'], '/runs/', workflow()?['run']?['name'])}

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Emerging Leaders recommendation with no comments: @{variables('varApplicant')}
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
@{variables('varSupName')} submitted the supervisor recommendation for @{variables('varApplicant')} without comments. It was saved as Received.

Item: @{variables('varItemLink')}

@{variables('varSupName')} did not respond to the supervisor recommendation request within 12 days. Status set to Timed Out.

A late response in the Approvals app won't be captured; add it to the item by hand if one arrives.

Item: @{variables('varItemLink')}

The supervisor recommendation branch failed (for example, a disabled or unknown account). Status set to Error; the application will be marked Incomplete.

Item: @{variables('varItemLink')}
Run: @{concat('https://make.powerautomate.com/environments/', workflow()?['tags']?['environmentName'], '/flows/', workflow()?['name'], '/runs/', workflow()?['run']?['name'])}

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Reminder: Emerging Leaders recommendation request for @{variables('varApplicant')}
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Hi @{variables('varAlumName')},

This is a reminder that you have a recommendation request for @{variables('varApplicant')}. You'll find it in the Approvals app in Teams, or in your Outlook email from Power Automate.

Item: @{variables('varItemLink')}

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: Emerging Leaders recommendation with no comments: @{variables('varApplicant')}

@{variables('varAlumName')} submitted the program alumni recommendation for @{variables('varApplicant')} without comments. It was saved as Received.

Item: @{variables('varItemLink')}

Both recommendations for @{variables('varApplicant')} are in. They're saved on the locked item (not included in this email).
